{{Otheruses|Water}}
'''Bad Water Pull''' was the name given to a single day once per year on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]] when the world's [[Moon/Legends|moons]] align in a specific way. During this time, the native [[Ergesh]] act irrationally, becoming violent and insane, almost as if intoxicated. Offworlders were encouraged to stay away from the natives on that day.
